Title: Question: raw:true in the relational queries
Description: Hi,

Assuming I have the next relations described:

``` javascript
    models.User.belongsToMany(models.Role,{through:'user__role',foreignKey:'users_id',otherKey:'roles_id'});
```

So in the code I do the next:

``` javascript
User.find(2298139).then(function(user){
                    user.getRoles().then(function(roles){
                        console.log(roles);
                        reply(roles);
                    });
                });
```

And I want to receive the plain result, without the sequelize wrappings.

The questions are:
1. How and where should I inject `{options: {raw: true}}`
2. How can I know that the `raw:true` had worked? I mean how the roles object would be different then?

Looking forward to receive any answer.

Regards,
